rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296B62700000000}Then let's depart.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296B72700000000}I'm sorry to put you to the trouble
of taking all of us back
to our respective continents.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B82700000000}Not at all.
We've dragged you all over the place,
so it's the least we can do.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296990000000000}Besides, unfortunately,
we can't cross the Cloud Sea on our own.
We're counting on you.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296B92700000000}But are you sure it's all right?
Even Daba and the others are coming along.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296BA2700000000}People from Pentagona caused all this trouble.
Surely we won't be punished
for at least seeing you off.


{C:81958296BB2700000000}Oops.
That was off-limits, wasn't it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BC2700000000}That's right, Daba.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296BD2700000000}But that's how
we all met.

{C:8190B801}{C:819582969A0000000000}Right, it's all over now.
Let's stop pointing fingers
at one another.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296BE2700000000}Then let's depart.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296C02700000000}I hope it's really over.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296C12700000000}Did you say something, Chirico?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296C32700000000}No...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C42700000000}Then...
The Astante is departing!!




{x00}

What are you doing?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296C62700000000}Oh, sooorry!
We're heading to another continent, right?

rows.en:
{C:81932201}{C:81958296C92700000000}My name is
Albatro Null Eiji Asuka.
I request permission to land.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296CA2700000000}What's the status
of the maintenance deck?

{C:81938700}{C:81958296CC2700000000}The maintenance deck
is ready whenever you are.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296CD2700000000}You have permission to land
on the maintenance deck.

{C:81932201}{C:81958296CF2700000000}Thank you.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902201}{C:81958296D02700000000}Luckily, I escaped Posaydal's attacks
thanks to the Cloud Sea.

{C:81958296D22700000000}{C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000} plans to obtain the Cloud System
and embark on
a campaign of continental conquest.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D32700000000}But the Cloud System...
Who on earth could...?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296D42700000000}I don't know that much.
I could barely make it here in {C:819782830400}Layzner{C:819782830000}
myself.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296D52700000000}Now we have no choice
but to go to Grados,
right?


{C:81930100}{C:81958296D62700000000}Let's go, Eiji.
There's nobody else anywhere
who can stop this fighting.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296D72700000000}I'll help you
in every way I can.




{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D82700000000}Huh?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D92700000000}What is it, Nelfea?

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296EE2700000000}There's abnormal movement
in the Cloud Stream.


{C:81930400}{C:81958296DC2700000000}Hey! That's what
I was about to say!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DD2700000000}This isn't the time to fool around!
So what's... Oh.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296DE2700000000}I'm sorry
to call you away from your busy schedule.

{C:81930B00}{C:819582969B0000000000}Don't worry about it.
If you've summoned me,
something serious must have happened.

{C:81930700}{C:81958296DF2700000000}We've identified the mastermind behind this incident.
It's that man.
The one who was our enemy during the civil war...

{C:81930900}{C:819582969C0000000000}That man...
Is that true, Kyo?!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296E02700000000}That's why we asked you to come, Admiral.
Against that man,
they stand virtually no chance.

{C:81930A00}{C:81958296E12700000000}So that's why you had me check out
Astante II and the new FT.


{C:81930700}{C:81958296E22700000000}I'm asking you too, Admiral.
Please authorize the use of Astante II.


{C:81930B00}{C:819582969D0000000000}Wind,
you're ready to sortie, then?

{C:81930A00}{C:81958296E42700000000}Of course!
I've got everything in perfect shape.

{C:81930B00}{C:819582969E0000000000}Very well. I authorize the sortie.
I'll handle all dealings
with the government myself.


{x00}

{C:81900600}{C:81958296E52700000000}Thank you very much!!

{C:81900700}{C:81958296E62700000000}Time is of the essence.
We're launching at once.
Let's go!!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296E72700000000}Then, Admiral,
we'll take our leave.

{C:81900B00}{C:819582969F0000000000}Very well. Take care.

rows.en:
{C:81900B00}{C:81958296A00000000000}What are you doing?
You two should go as well.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296E82700000000}Is that all right?

{C:81900B00}{C:81958296A10000000000}Against that man,
even Akatsuki and the others may be outmatched.
Go and help them.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296E92700000000}Understood!
I, Wind Shiga,
will gladly go!

{C:81958296EA2700000000}Hey, let's go, Tail!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296A20000000000}We're off, Admiral!!
